title: Qwen3-TTS (speech)
description: Qwen3-TTS on a server that speaks OpenAI's speech API, on this machine or your network, as gohort's voice. Such a server lists its voices at /voices rather than /audio/voices, and this template reads them there, for the Voice field's choices and for the check that a voice in use is still offered.
setup_notes: Start the Qwen3-TTS server, then give its address here, usually ending in /v1. The connector takes no key. Model and Default voice each have a List of what the server offers: a CustomVoice model names a fixed set of voices (ryan, serena, vivian and others). Always name a voice: a request with none can stop such a server. Choose it under Capabilities > Speech (TTS); Test there speaks a short sentence.

questions.name: name
questions.label: Connector name
questions.help: Lowercase letters, digits, dashes and underscores; the speech settings list it by this name.

config.name: base_url
config.label: Server address
config.help: The address its /audio/speech is under, usually ending in /v1: http://localhost:8090/v1, say.

config.name: model
config.label: Model
config.help: The Qwen3-TTS model the server runs. List shows the models it offers (its /models).

config.name: voice
config.label: Default voice
config.help: Used when the speech settings name none: one of the model's voices, ryan say. The speech settings' Voice overrides it. List shows the voices the server's model offers.
